title: 국회의원선거구획정위원회 구성 및 운영 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 국회의원선거구획정위원회 구성 및 운영 등에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Duties of the Committee)
(1) The Committee shall prepare a draft delimitation of constituencies for the election of members of the National Assembly (hereinafter referred to as "constituencies") in accordance with the standards prescribed in Article 25 (1) of the Act, prepare a report stating the reasons for the draft and other necessary matters, and submit it to the Speaker of the National Assembly by [unreadable text concerning the election deadline in the supplied Korean source] six months before the general election held upon expiration of the terms of members of the National Assembly: Provided, That where special circumstances exist, such as a change in the constituency system for election of members of the National Assembly or adjustment of the number of seats, the Speaker may extend the deadline for submission in consultation with the representative members of each negotiating party. <Amended on January 21, 2000; April 5, 2011>
(2) Upon receiving a report under paragraph (1), the Speaker of the National Assembly shall, without delay, refer it to the relevant standing committee or the special committee responsible for reviewing matters concerning the delimitation of constituencies. <Newly Inserted on January 21, 2000>
